via: management API /database/query, read-only select, CLI keychain token
query:
select
  (select count(*)::int from orders) as all_orders,
  (select count(*)::int from orders where status in ('paid','partially_fulfilled','fulfilled','platform_settled')) as paid_orders,
  (select count(*)::int from payments where status in ('succeeded','platform_settled')) as succeeded_payments,
  (select count(*)::int from payments p join orders o on o.id=p.order_id left join auth.users u on u.id=o.user_id
     where p.status in ('succeeded','platform_settled')
     and p.cardcom_transaction_id is not null
     and p.cardcom_transaction_id !~ '^(mock|test|e2e)'
     and coalesce(u.email,'') !~* '(e2e|test|example\.com|playwright|mock)') as real_sales,
  (select max(created_at) from orders) as last_order_at,
  (select count(*)::int from orders where created_at > '2026-10-21T08:53:56Z') as orders_since_last_scan,
  now() as measured_at
